powers.name: Lightning Arc
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. It deals 1d6 electricity damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Electricity Resistance
powers.summary: Gain electricity resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.

powers.name: Speak with Animals
powers.summary: Speak with animals for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + cleric level. These rounds need not be consecutive.

powers.name: Animal Companion
powers.summary: Gain an animal companion using an effective druid level equal to cleric level – 3.

powers.name: Touch of Chaos
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, force the target to roll twice and take the worse result on every d20 roll during its next round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Chaos Blade
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the anarchic special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

powers.name: Bleeding Touch
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, cause a living creature to take 1d6 bleed damage each round for rounds equal to half cleric level. Healing or a DC 15 Heal check ends it. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Death's Embrace
powers.summary: Negative energy channeled by the cleric heals the cleric instead of harming them; excess healing is not gained as temporary hit points.

powers.name: Destructive Smite
powers.summary: Declare before a melee attack to gain a morale bonus on its damage roll equal to half cleric level, minimum +1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Destructive Aura
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Attacks made within it gain bonus damage equal to half cleric level and critical threats automatically confirm.

powers.name: Acid Dart
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. It deals 1d6 acid damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Acid Resistance
powers.summary: Gain acid resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.
